The bowl is small, about 12 cm across at the rim, and it holds a swirl of soft-serve in two colors, vanilla and caramel or chocolate. The swirl is tall, roughly 10 cm, but thin and ribbon-like. I estimate about 110 g of soft-serve in total, split roughly evenly between the two flavors. Soft-serve is about 180 kcal per 100 g.
